dataset: Maryland iMAP Prince George's County bare-earth LiDAR DEM
acquisition: Late 2020 to early 2021, per the service's archived metadata
verticalDatum: NAVD88; raster values in meters, independently checked at McKeldin Library with USGS EPQS
unitVerification: USGS result and query URL are retained in umd-terrain-samples.json. The ArcGIS metadata retains native feet VCS information, so the units were not inferred solely from that field.
adaptation: Grid query coordinates invert the same McKeldin-to-Miller rotated/scaled frame as prepare-maryland-full-layout.mjs, including its 1.65 x and 1.7 z spacing expansion.
Runtime subtracts a 14 meter local datum; it does not amplify the vertical range.
A 3 by 3 weighted filter smooths survey micro-detail for walking. Existing building positions, some of which are deliberately displaced, receive authored level pads with softened transitions.
The legacy McKeldin, Miller and STAMP ground platforms use their actual source building-center elevations because the old central plan was compressed separately.
All draped surfaces conform to one 12.5 game unit triangular lattice. This avoids lawn and road interpenetration despite independently authored mesh tessellation.
Building heights, detailed steps, entrances and local retaining structures are authored, not measured by this bare-earth DEM.
This is a geographically informed game adaptation, not a 1:1 campus survey or a representation of all construction changes since the LiDAR flight.
